ptah.run/mysql/index-block-size.constraint: The KEY_BLOCK_SIZE hint a declaration states for an index, in kilobytes. An empty object declares an index without one.
The KEY_BLOCK_SIZE hint an index holds, and whether the server keeps one on it at all: MariaDB always, MySQL only with ROW_FORMAT=COMPRESSED.

canonicalization: A zero hint and a hint the server does not retain are omitted.
